tasks.short: Revise psychology curricula and teaching methods

steps.what: Evaluate curricula against learning needs, research developments, and student difficulties
Choose revised objectives, sequence, content, and methods of instruction
Write revised course content from the chosen instructional approach

loop.purpose: Draft wording that implements the teacher's chosen revisions
loop.input: revision brief, selected source extracts, current curriculum
loop.output: curriculum revision draft with source references and change explanations
loop.check: Teacher checks psychological claims, alignment with objectives, sequence, and suitability of examples
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported content is rewritten manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot express a substantive change in instructional explanation

steps.what: Validate the revised curriculum and hand over the agreed proposal

tasks.design: Keep curriculum evaluation and instructional decisions with the teacher. A bounded drafting step in {DOCS} expresses the chosen changes, followed by substantive validation before programme-level approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revision prose has to reflect several interdependent teaching choices.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded language draft can use an explicit brief and selected sources.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a revised sequence helps students understand competing psychological explanations.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher connects observed learning difficulties to sound instructional changes.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of rewriting time becomes time for checking instructional coherence; curriculum authority is unchanged.

reach.learn: Outcome mapping and programme approval requirements

evidence.claim: Drafting curriculum prose from teacher-selected decisions is an E1 design hypothesis, not a demonstrated improvement in learning.

assumptions: Boundary covers curricular evaluation and revision proposals; lesson media production and formal programme approval are separate work.

Teacher produces the revision brief in s2: objective identifiers, proposed sequence, chosen content changes, audience, source passages, and method rationale; capture time remains in s2. Missing or ambiguous fields return to manual revision.
Test existing document templates and revision tracking before a custom drafting service.
The drafting service receives approved teaching sources, not identifiable student records; aggregate evidence is prepared in s1.
unknowns: Permitted source material and model access
research_questions: Does independent review find unsupported psychological claims or objective mismatches in the draft?

already_counted.description: Validate revised content and discuss the proposal

incremental.description: Maintain the drafting brief and check recurring source errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=91.25; gross 8.75 minus 4 upkeep gives net 4.75. Range assumes a revision with reusable source material; major curriculum redesign may leave no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct psychological research and publish findings

steps.what: Design research and establish ethical, methodological, and access requirements
Conduct the authorised study and interpret the research findings
Write publication sections from verified findings and selected references

loop.purpose: Draft prose describing results already established by the researcher
loop.input: verified analysis, interpretation notes, study limitations, selected references
loop.output: manuscript draft with traceable claims and unresolved questions
loop.check: Researcher compares every result, uncertainty statement, interpretation, and citation against source material
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported passages are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A formatting template cannot express nuanced interpretation and study limitations

steps.what: Verify the final manuscript, agree authorship, and submit for publication

tasks.design: Keep research design, study conduct, and interpretation with the researcher. In {DOCS}, a bounded loop drafts manuscript prose from verified findings; the researcher verifies the exact final submission and performs publication handover.
tasks.previous_blocker: A fluent manuscript can misstate results or conceal limitations.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafts can be constrained to a researcher-prepared findings pack and checked claim by claim.
tasks.still_hard: Valid study design, participant care, inference, and research integrity.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher recognises rival explanations and decides which claims the study can defend.
tasks.altitude: Research decisions stay with the teacher; a modest reduction in prose drafting may support closer verification.

evidence.claim: A source-constrained manuscript draft may reduce prose work; it does not establish scientific validity or time savings.
Leiden's memo reports that fabricated references can pass plagiarism checks, supporting independent citation verification.

assumptions: Boundary includes teacher research and publication effort; participant and collaborator effort are excluded and unchanged. Existing authorised observations are generated during study conduct in s2, after the protocol is established.

Teacher prepares result tables, analysis version, claim-to-result links, limitations, and verified reference identifiers in s2 and s3; capture and source checking remain in those shares. No missing result is inferred; use manual prose when the pack is incomplete.
Check existing reporting templates and reference-manager tools before custom integration.
Only approved, appropriately de-identified reporting material enters drafting; collection and analysis are not delegated.
research_questions: Does a blinded review detect changed statistical meaning, unsupported causal language, or false references?

already_counted.description: Verify final scientific claims and submit the approved version

incremental.description: Maintain the reporting pack and check drafting-related errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact manuscript, figures, references, authorship and destination snapshot; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94; gross 6 minus 4 upkeep gives net 2. Range concerns prose-heavy reporting of already verified findings; exploratory or participant-intensive studies may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and use multimedia psychology course materials

steps.what: Develop multimedia explanations, examples, and an accessible course structure
Create recordings and check transcripts, illustrations, and psychological examples
Assemble course pages and attach specified media using the learning platform
Test course navigation and accessibility, then release and use materials with students

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} templates and import functions to assemble pages from a teacher-prepared course manifest. The teacher creates and checks the media, tests the staged course, and controls release and classroom use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated page assembly can consume effort after content is already settled.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing course templates can reuse an explicit ordered media manifest.
tasks.still_hard: Accessible explanations, accurate demonstrations, and meaningful use of media in teaching.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher judges when a visual explanation obscures an important psychological distinction.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated page assembly leaves time to test the learner's route through the course.

reach.learn: Keyboard testing, transcript quality, and learner testing

evidence.claim: Native course templating and media import can reduce repeated assembly when the platform supports the required structure.

assumptions: Boundary starts from agreed objectives, excluding curriculum redesign; it includes media creation, assembly, release, and teacher use. OTHER is a recording and media-editing application.

Teacher produces the course manifest in s1 and completes it in s2: page identifier, title, sequence, content file, media file, transcript file, alternative text, and intended visibility. Capture and correcting file references remain in s1 and s2. Missing or invalid entries stop assembly and are entered manually.
Test native LMS templates and import first; custom code is unnecessary unless their limitations are measured.
Only staged internal pages are automated; the teacher checks final content, navigation, permissions, and accessibility before release.
research_questions: Does manifest preparation plus correction consume less time than repeated manual page assembly?

already_counted.description: Test the learner experience and control release

incremental.description: Maintain course templates and correct import mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact staged course version including pages, media, transcripts, visibility and student audience; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85; gross 15 minus 5 upkeep gives net 10. Range assumes repeated assembly across several media pages; single-page resources may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain office hours to advise psychology students

steps.what: Maintain scheduled office hours and advise or assist students with their concerns

tasks.design: Retain teacher office hours and direct student discussion. Use the existing {CALENDAR} for published availability without attributing a new labour saving to current scheduling tools.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student concerns need context, listening, and individual academic judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: No new automation is proposed for the consultation itself.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing academic confusion from issues requiring specialist support.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher builds trust and adapts advice to the student's situation.
tasks.altitude: Office-hour responsibilities and decision rights stay the same.

reach.task: Recognise when a student needs specialist academic support
reach.learn: Referral boundaries and available support routes

evidence.claim: Individual student advising requires contextual dialogue; no time reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's scheduled office-hour provision and advice; specialist services retain their existing separate work.

Teacher maintains published office-hour times in the existing calendar; students supply their questions during discussion. No new structured input, extraction, automated advice, or capture requirement is introduced.
Native scheduling remains sufficient; no custom system is proposed.
Zero upkeep is justified because the existing consultation and calendar process are unchanged.
research_questions: Do students receive clear next steps and know how to reach specialist support?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving are zero. Direct advising and scheduled availability remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The psychology teacher retains research, curriculum, and student-care decisions while checking bounded drafts and staged course packages.
reach: Accessible course testing with an instructional designer
Traceable research reporting with a research assistant
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who can publish clearer learning materials while preserving substantive research and student dialogue.
